GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
